headline: Which sectors are credit flows prioritizing?
summary: According to the State Bank of Vietnam, outstanding credit to the economy exceeded 20.15 quadrillion dong after the first half, up 8.37% from end-2025. Lending is rising fastest in industry, services, exports and high technology.
why: Credit growth reflects the pace of bank lending to the economy, which central banks and investors watch as a signal of domestic demand and financial conditions.
